gain_witness.meaning: Structural nonidentifiability witness on already-observed audio, not real picking-force validation

null_calibration.rigs: all 8 non-teacher rig indices, not family-disjoint
null_calibration.statistic: maximum absolute raw median-probe correction over every calibration curve and 80-8000 Hz bin

conditional_deployment_eq: Only evaluate null gate on selected chains if the oracle E0/E1 gate passes; otherwise record not validated
scope: Keep multi-DI half-octave spectral baseline unchanged. No per-clip normalization. Digital pre-level is not physical picking force; source hardware gain unknown. No Free Bird. Independent recordings required for validation; missing assets must not be replaced by previously used holdouts.
